teams.detail: Idle during the All-Star break, sitting 2nd in the AL West behind Texas (49-47) and holding a wild-card spot. Next up: at home vs. the Giants on Saturday, July 18 (NBCS).

Fell to Phoenix 100-88 in Summer League pool play as Detroit was held under 15 points in both the 1st and 4th quarters. Brice Williams led with 24 points and No. 17 pick Ebuka Okorie added 16; Detroit plays Miami in a consolation game Friday.

The Paul Allen Estate's $9.6 billion sale to a Khosla family-led group still needs ratification from at least 24 of the other 31 owners. RB Zach Charbonnet is progressing well in his ACL recovery ahead of a late-July checkup; training camp opens July 25 in Renton with nine public practices, and the team is set to appear on HBO's Hard Knocks in August.

RB Jordan Washington, carted off during spring practice, is targeting a late-July return under coach Jedd Fisch. The Huskies added CB commit Censere Gaylord to a recruiting class that already includes a 4-star cornerback; season opens Sept. 5 vs. Washington State in the Apple Cup at Husky Stadium.

Coach Danny Sprinkle is rebuilding through the portal after losing Zoom Diallo and seeing Hannes Steinbach taken 14th overall by Charlotte in the NBA Draft. Croatian power forward Boris Tišma has committed to fill out next season's frontcourt.

headlines.headline: James Harden declines $42.3M option as Cavaliers work on new deal; Warriors see themselves as LeBron dark horse
headlines.detail: Cavaliers guard James Harden opted out of the final $42.3 million year of his contract, with Harden and Cleveland now negotiating a new multiyear deal rather than testing the open market. Golden State privately views itself as a dark-horse contender for free-agent LeBron James even as reports suggest James is leaning toward an Eastern Conference return.

headlines.headline: Patrick Mahomes on track for Week 1 return from ACL tear against Broncos
headlines.detail: Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes remains on schedule to be ready for Kansas City's Week 1 Monday night opener against the AFC West champion Denver Broncos, following the season-ending ACL tear that ended his 2025 campaign early.

headlines.headline: $10 million QB Darian Mensah headlines a portal cycle reshaping the ACC and Big Ten title picture
headlines.detail: Miami's move to sign Duke transfer Darian Mensah — who led the ACC with 3,973 passing yards and 34 touchdowns last season — followed a legal fight after Duke sought a restraining order to block his portal entry. Penn State added Iowa State's Rocco Becht as both programs bet on transfer quarterbacks ahead of fall camp.

headlines.headline: Kansas vaults into preseason Top 25 behind No. 1 recruit Tyran Stokes as portal churn tops 2,700 players
headlines.detail: Kansas jumped into early 2026-27 rankings after landing five-star forward Tyran Stokes, the No. 1 recruit in the class since AJ Dybantsa's 2023 reclassification, while Texas's class built around Marcus Spears Jr. remains in the national title conversation.
